read.title: Buy Box Status: Vitamin Toner
read.text:
Team,

Over the past three days, we lost the Buy Box for our Vitamin Toner on 40% of page views. A third-party reseller undercut our price by $1.50, and Amazon now features their offer instead of ours.

To win back the Buy Box, we will adjust our repricing rules so that our price never goes more than $0.50 above the lowest offer. We will also keep enough FBA stock, because low inventory can hurt our chances.

Please report any new sellers on the listing to me. We need to stay competitive without starting a price war.

Thanks,
Minsu

write.en: Write a short update to your manager about losing the Buy Box and your plan to win it back.
write.model:
Hi Jiwon,

We lost the Buy Box for our cica cream this morning. Another seller undercut our price by $2. I'd like to update our repricing rules today to win back the Buy Box while protecting our margin. We also have enough FBA stock to stay competitive.

Thanks,
Minsu
